analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY is in a confirmed uptrend (+3.6% vs SMA50, positive slope) which is constructive, but this backdrop does NOT justify forcing trades. The portfolio is already 94% deployed across 5 positions with only $1,125 of remaining headroom — far below the minimum needed to properly size even the smallest position (1.5% equity risk on a $101k book = ~$1,525 at risk; a $6 stop on a $50 stock would need 254 shares = $12,700 in capital, well above available room). CAPACITY VERDICT: No new buys are possible without violating sizing discipline or breaching the 25% concentration cap.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
- A (+12.54%): Agilent is working well. Thesis (life-sciences instrumentation quality compounder) intact. No technical deterioration. Hold.
- AMP (+2.60%): Ameriprise is plodding but above water. Wealth management thesis intact in a rising market. Hold.
- LMT (+3.13%): Defense spending tailwinds remain. Thesis intact. Hold.
- MCO (+1.42%): Moody's credit-cycle and data-services business is durable. Modest gain, no reason to exit.
- TEL (+0.59%): TE Connectivity appears on today's screened candidate list (basing, fundamentals solid, positive EPS revisions). Thesis intact, trend basing constructively. Hold.

NO SELLS RECOMMENDED: None of the five positions shows a thesis-break signal (fundamental deterioration, price below stop, or sector headwind reversal). Selling a quality business in a functioning uptrend simply to generate cash would be performance-chasing in reverse.

WHY ZERO NEW BUYS TODAY: (1) Physical capacity constraint — $1,125 remaining headroom cannot support a properly sized position. (2) The portfolio is already at max concentration (5 positions). (3) WDAY has re-appeared on the candidate list but is +27.5% above its SMA50 and earnings in 17 days — far too extended and near-term binary risk; the three prior stop-outs here reinforce discipline. (4) APH is at 90% of its 52-week range — prohibited by hard rules. (5) Several interesting names (ADBE, IT, BRO, ROP) are either too extended above SMA50 or have downward-sloping SMA50 — do not meet the basing entry criterion at these levels. Cash is a position. Patience here IS the edge.
